description: This file defines a PHP trait named IsEmptyTrait within the namespace OrangeHRM\Core\Api\V2\Validator\Helpers. The trait provides a utility method isEmpty() to check if a value is null or an empty string, which can be reused in other classes for validation purposes.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the given value is either null or an empty string, returning true if so.
